message: v10.7.4 upgrades tutorial narration to a human-voice mode that automatically prefers the most natural available neural/natural/online speech voice for the selected language. Microsoft Edge is preferred at launch to maximize access to Windows Natural voices, with Chrome and Brave as fallbacks. German prioritizes high-quality German Natural/Neural voices and English prioritizes modern English Natural/Neural voices. The complete v10.7.3 AITL2 license gate, signed live revocation checks, Windows-protected activation and 24-hour offline grace remain unchanged.
